image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large common iguana resting on a branch. The iguana's head is tilted upward with eyes closed, showcasing the prominent dewlap, subtympanic shield, and dorsal crest spines. The skin texture is highly detailed, showing granular scales transitioning to larger plates on the head. Coloration is a mix of green, brown, and orange hues. The background is dark and out of focus, likely foliage.
